name: ClickDock – Instant Message, Call, Contact & More
author: AITC International

sections.description:
ClickDock is your all-in-one floating contact plugin that makes it easy for users to reach you on their favorite platforms. Whether it’s WhatsApp, Messenger, Call, or Email, ClickDock displays a sticky CTA dock on the bottom-right corner of your website for seamless communication and faster conversions.

✨ Features:
– Add multiple contact methods (WhatsApp, Messenger, Call, Email, SMS, Telegram, Line, and more)
– Custom buttons and links for any external or internal destination
– Track clicks for each contact method (Google Analytics and internal logs)
– Display dock only on mobile, desktop, or both
– Set working hours for availability
– Auto popup welcome messages
– Choose from multiple icon styles and animations
– Light and dark theme toggle
– Custom branding support (upload your own icons)
– Full control over widget position and behavior
– Lightweight, fast, and easy to use
– Enable or disable the widget with one click (activation control)
– Scroll-to-top button included for enhanced UX

Use Cases:
– Increase leads by giving visitors direct contact options
– Boost support efficiency with quick access to chat platforms
– Enhance mobile UX with sticky floating action icons
– Track which channels your users prefer the most
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/clickdock directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to ClickDock Settings in your dashboard
  4. Customize your widget icons, layout, and availability
sections.faq:
Can I choose which icons to show?

Yes! You can toggle icons like WhatsApp, Call, Email, Telegram, and more.

Can I set different behavior for mobile and desktop?

Absolutely. You can configure visibility per device type.

Can I track which icons are being clicked?

Yes, ClickDock provides basic click tracking and can be integrated with Google Analytics.

Is ClickDock GDPR compliant?

ClickDock does not collect or store user data. However, depending on the services you link to (e.g., WhatsApp), you may need to comply with external privacy policies.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, ClickDock is fully compatible with all major page builders (Elementor, WPBakery, Gutenberg, etc.)
